title: Introduce operator-claim-witness service with KMS-backed escrow and geo-seal enforcement
author: Ava Park
description:
Motivation: Several incidents in Q4 revealed gaps when operator-scoped JWTs were accepted without a short-lived proof of locality. This PR introduces a lightweight operator-claim-witness service that records ephemeral operator claims, attaches a KMS-backed escrow proof, and returns a geo-seal assertion used by the RBAC v2 decision path and audit pipeline. Goals: (1) provide cryptographic, per-request operator provenance that can be verified by downstream services; (2) enforce region pinning for operator actions where tenant or service policies demand locality; (3) integrate with existing audit forwarder so proofs are attached to audit events for non-repudiation.

Summary of changes: added a new internal service (operator-witness) with a slim HTTP/gRPC API for SubmitClaim and VerifyClaim, wired KMS envelope wrapping for escrowed claim blobs, added a geo-seal module that signs an assertion including zone-id and kms-key-tag, augmented the RBAC v2 admission path to consult the witness verifier when a tenant policy requires geo-sealed operator proofs, and extended the audit-forwarder to index claim references and include proof metadata. This is implemented behind a runtime feature flag (operator_claim_witness.enabled) and a staged rollout plan is included.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: ENG-8591 attached - [x] Unit tests for witness store and verifier - [x] Integration tests exercising RBAC decision when geo-seal required - [x] KMS key policy templates for escrow keys - [x] Helm chart values and installer notes for Private deployments - [x] Migration plan (stepwise rollout, opt-in tenants) - [x] Security review and threat model completed by SEC-117

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy witness service to canary region (staged as feature flag off by default). 2) Enable verification-only mode: services accept proofs if presented but do not require them. 3) Once telemetry shows correct acceptance rates, flip tenant policies to require geo-sealed proofs for selected self-hosted tenants. 4) If verification errors exceed threshold, automatic fallback to native RBAC decision is applied and an alert fires.

Testing: unit tests (pkg/witness/*) and integration harness (tests/integration/witness_flow) added. Manual test steps and LocalStack-compatible KMS shim included for developer QA. Full e2e tested in perf-canary for latency impact (adds ~6ms median to authenticated operator path when using local KMS cache).

review_conversation: Diego Morales: Overall design looks solid. Two asks: make the RPC idempotent for retries and ensure verifier handles clock skew gracefully.
Ava Park: Addressed both. Added idempotency token to SubmitClaim and a 2-minute tower for skew tolerance in verifier (configurable).
Priya Shah: Please add explicit attestations in the audit event schema so downstream SIEMs can map proofs to operator sessions.
Ava Park: Added proof_reference and proof_kms_key fields to the audit event envelope and updated forwarder indexer. Added schema migration note in docs.
Ethan Liu: CI showed intermittent flake in tests/integration/witness_flow due to LocalStack KMS throttling. Can we add a retry in the test harness?
Ava Park: Added exponential backoff in harness and a flag to use cached test keys to avoid throttling in CI. Reran CI and green.
